content: {"id":"4f07ee67-5c16-44f4-adb6-b57aeeebea7b","type":"https://serlo.org/editor","variant":"serlo-org","domainOrigin":"serlo.org","version":2,"editorVersion":"0.22.0","dateModified":"2025-02-26T18:24:49.360Z","document":{"plugin":"course","state":{"content":{"plugin":"rows","state":[]},"pages":[{"content":{"plugin":"rows","state":[{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Wie bereits erklärt, ist das ViewModel für die Logik zuständig und beinhaltet die Models, also die Daten."}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Damit die View auf das ViewModel zugreifen kann, müssen wir im code-behind den DataContext angeben:"}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"namespace DateiverwaltungPro.Views {    ///     ///     Interaction logic for MainWindowView.xaml    ///     public partial class MainWindowView {        public MainWindowView() {            InitializeComponent();            DataContext = new MainWindowViewModel();        }    }}"}]},{"type":"h","level":3,"children":[{"text":"Aufgabe 1:"}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Erstelle ein Textbox Element über dem Nummernblock."}]}],"id":"7d4403d6-aa19-408d-86bc-6bef2ff13ab4"},{"plugin":"spoiler","state":{"title":"Lösung Aufgabe 1:","content":{"plugin":"rows","state":[{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":""}]}],"id":"2b8cf132-e613-4791-af76-3d7109c23ad3"}],"id":"7b3a628c-ad7c-4f04-9427-1bd2ba62448a"}},"id":"07a4fcf5-6588-4952-a0df-4d59616cc126"},{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"h","level":3,"children":[{"text":"Aufgabe 2:"}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Erstelle in deinem ViewModel eine Property mit dem Namen FunnyNumber vom Typ string. Die Property soll ein Backing-Field haben."}]}],"id":"27109af6-2ad8-49c6-bfc9-4d0d47d6213f"},{"plugin":"spoiler","state":{"title":"Lösung Aufgabe 2:","content":{"plugin":"rows","state":[{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Dein ViewModel könnte jetzt in etwa wie folgt aussehen:"}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"namespace DateiverwaltungPro.Views {    public class MainWindowViewModel {        private string _funnyNumber;"}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"    public string FunnyNumber {        get {            return _funnyNumber;        }        set {            _funnyNumber = value;        }    }}"}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"}"}]}],"id":"81d99cbf-9aa8-4e4b-ae3f-a5eaf8de8884"}],"id":"586e35f3-78ed-4807-bf42-38ab7d7d47e5"}},"id":"3ff93087-8413-48b8-b773-296d2f6d3bdb"},{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"h","level":2,"children":[{"text":"Databinding"}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Um den Inhalt der Textbox an diese Property zu binden, verpassen wir ihr folgendes Attribut:"}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Text=\"{Binding FunnyNumber}\""}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Wenn du nun der Property im Konstruktor einen Wert zuweist und das Programm startest, solltest du den Text in der TextBox sehen können:"}]}],"id":"9bec2db0-6be0-4fd3-9e24-62247593b8a9"},{"plugin":"image","state":{"src":"https://assets.serlo.org/legacy/5807e752f10c1_000c50cc7d7030b126929c722ccb09e4a21a10e4.PNG","alt":"","caption":{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{}]}],"id":"80edba8b-989e-4d66-b9e5-4fb11c15defa"}},"id":"46d58b3f-4377-4f8f-8e7b-44b3828917a2"},{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"h","level":2,"children":[{"text":"Commands"}]}],"id":"d0d0daf1-ee1f-476b-8131-8c2fae61c873"}],"id":"95fe502d-1863-4a05-b62e-e230ed8f6f4f"},"id":"64393-course-page","title":"ViewModel 2/2"}]},"id":"39ec3c17-3c91-4ea1-8603-a03e80ca4fc5"}}
